intro: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER CAMPAIGN) The Ashwick ferry has not crossed in three days. The landing is empty except for Maela Vey and a bell with no tongue.
(ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) Find out what happened to the last crossing. The boathouse ledger may explain why the bell went silent.
(PLACEHOLDER PRESENTATION) This is an original, non-canonical scenario built from content files. Prose, maps and art are stand-ins.
defeat: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The black water takes another ferryman. The bell stays silent.
(PLACEHOLDER DEFEAT STATE) Load a save or begin again.
victory: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The crossing is settled. The bell, the token and the water have had their say.
(ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) Maela has the last account. The landing will keep it, or it will not.
(PLACEHOLDER PRESENTATION) The objective is complete. You can keep exploring, inspect the party, or save.
